cues.text: - [Narrator] This is "The Economics of Aldi." So how does the company keep its prices so low?
cues.en: - [Narrator] This is "The Economics of Aldi." So how does the company keep its prices so low?

cues.en: If it's cheap, they may assume it's lower quality, which is why Aldi's no-frill strategy is so effective.
